doc: Changelogs and store text stay coherent on all three apps, on a free weekly GitHub Actions run, without paid AI and without removing published ids.
schedule_note: Tuesdays 05:10 UTC (06:10 Europe/Paris in winter). Also workflow_dispatch.
rules: A changelog version key must belong to this app's series. Foreign 9.x keys on stable or 5.x/9.x keys on Bastien are removed.
Notes come from commits since the previous version really published for this app (ledger), else since the previous bump. Always en+fr. No personal names, no internal P/GH ids.
Published driver ids, flow-card ids, capability ids and mfr+pid couples are never removed or renamed.
Driver names are unique per locale. Each locale is in its own language. Accents from the known word list are applied (Latin-1 only, no char above U+00FF in the fixer).
Two flow cards in one driver must not render the same title in a locale; the custom card is retitled or the wording is distinguished. Cards are not deleted.
Bastien app.json is the official HomeyCompose output (P3079), never normalise().
Leftover issues that the fixer will not touch go to the report artifact only: no new GitHub issue, no forum post, no email.
